hypothesis: Disclosed seat net buying may confirm an existing Donchian regime; net selling may veto that regime.
scope: 10 pre-period-selected main-board names; exploratory historical comparison, not a validated trading strategy.
known_feedback: 2026 portfolio outcomes from earlier factor work were already viewed. This is not a pristine external holdout.
selection_rule: Exact seat names ranked by distinct stock-day count in seat_fit, minimum 2, top 10; no return-based or celebrity selection.
availability: Historical publication time is missing. Primary assumes available by next session close, execution no earlier than the following session open. Also report one extra session delay. Not a verified historical timestamp.
h1: During an active trend regime, a qualifying selected-seat net buy activates entry eligibility until the regime ends. This is our signal state, not the seat's holdings.
h4: During an active trend regime, a qualifying selected-seat net sell vetoes it until the next new Donchian regime. Sell wins when buy and sell coexist.
